thread:
claire: anyone else need a midweek mood boost? meet Glimmer, my axolotl. he makes bubble rings and judges my plant care. pic: https://cdn.redwood.ai/pets/glimmer1.jpg :squid: :sparkles:

ben: wait what is a bubble ring? this sounds like aquarium magic :eyes:

claire: tiny doughnut-shaped air rings he blows with his gills. short vid: https://cdn.redwood.ai/pets/glimmer-bubbles.mp4 

amrita: that is both scientifically impressive and deeply soothing :relieved: tank looks cozy, do you have glow substrate?

claire: yup, low-UV glow sand. he becomes a little neon noodle at dusk. also he steals floating spinach pieces like a tiny bandit :laughing:

jas: can we have a quick poll: who wants an office "mini-aquarium" corner for low-maintenance pets? compatibility note: no cats in the room, filtered air, and regular volunteer caretakers. :raised_hands:

ops-bot: Reminder: office pet policy: https://intranet.redwood.ai/policies/pet-day. Aquatic and exotic pets require prior approval from People Ops and Facilities. Please submit the aquatics intake form before proposing in-office tanks.

ben: i vote yes if someone will do weekly water checks. also can we make Glimmer an honorary code reviewer? :nerd_face:

amrita: seconded. also requesting tiny caption contest: "when the build passes vs when the build fails" (two photos incoming)

claire: uploading build-pass pic: https://cdn.redwood.ai/pets/glimmer-pass.jpg and fail pic: https://cdn.redwood.ai/pets/glimmer-fail.jpg — captions encouraged :party:

design-bot: sticker pack "glimmer-axi" added to #random_stickers (variants: bubble-ring, neon-noodle, spinach-thief) :partyparrot:

jas: caption vote cast: "passes: diplomatic nod, fails: immediately becomes a loaf" :laughing:
